STS2_AI_A_CARD_POTION_SMOKE_BOMB.title: Smoke Bomb
STS2_AI_A_CARD_POTION_SMOKE_BOMB.descrip:
The target player escapes combat.
If combat is not won, no rewards are received.
At the end of combat, they heal 3 HP for each round elapsed after escaping, up to 30 HP.
Cannot be used in boss or event combats.
